metadata.question: Does the water storage in Alabama decreases from 2003 to 2012?

data.raw_code: I'll analyze water storage changes in Alabama from 2003 to 2012 using GRACE terrestrial water storage data. 1. Search strategy: Use GRACE terrestrial water storage anomaly data (JPL Mascon product) for 2003 and 2012. 2. Masking strategy: GRACE data doesn't need cloud masking. Need to ensure valid data coverage. 3. Logic: Compare mean water storage anomaly values between the two years. Need to check for data availability and valid pixels. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions alabama = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [-88.4732, 35.0080], [-84.8882, 35.0080], [-84.8882, 30.2240], [-88.4732, 30.2240], [-88.4732, 35.0080] ]]) # Time periods: annual averages around 2003 and 2012 start_2003 = '2003-01-01' end_2003 = '2003-12-31' start_2012 = '2012-01-01' end_2012 = '2012-12-31' # 2. Data Acquisition - GRACE Mascon terrestrial water storage grace = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GRACE/MASCON_GRID_RL06_V2') .select('lwe_thickness') # liquid water equivalent thickness (cm) # Get 2003 data grace_2003 = grace.filterDate(start_2003, end_2003) grace_2012 = grace.filterDate(start_2012, end_2012) # Check collection sizes size_2003 = grace_2003.size().getInfo() size_2012 = grace_2012.size().getInfo() print(f"2003 Images: {size_2003}") print(f"2012 Images: {size_2012}") # Handle empty collections if size_2003 == 0 or size_2012 == 0: print("C1") exit() # Create annual means img_2003 = grace_2003.mean().clip(alabama) img_2012 = grace_2012.mean().clip(alabama) # 3. Calculate mean water storage anomalies val_2003 = img_2003.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=alabama, scale=50000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('lwe_thickness').getInfo() val_2012 = img_2012.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=alabama, scale=50000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('lwe_thickness').getInfo() print(f"2003 Mean Water Storage: {val_2003:.2f} cm") print(f"2012 Mean Water Storage: {val_2012:.2f} cm") # 5. data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
alabama = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[
    [-88.4732, 35.0080], [-84.8882, 35.0080],
    [-84.8882, 30.2240], [-88.4732, 30.2240],
    [-88.4732, 35.0080]
]])

# Time periods: annual averages around 2003 and 2012
start_2003 = '2003-01-01'
end_2003 = '2003-12-31'
start_2012 = '2012-01-01'
end_2012 = '2012-12-31'

# 2. Data Acquisition - GRACE Mascon terrestrial water storage
grace = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GRACE/MASCON_GRID_RL06_V2')
    .select('lwe_thickness')  # liquid water equivalent thickness (cm)

# Get 2003 data
grace_2003 = grace.filterDate(start_2003, end_2003)
grace_2012 = grace.filterDate(start_2012, end_2012)

# Check collection sizes
size_2003 = grace_2003.size().getInfo()
size_2012 = grace_2012.size().getInfo()
print(f"2003 Images: {size_2003}")
print(f"2012 Images: {size_2012}")

# Handle empty collections
if size_2003 == 0 or size_2012 == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# Create annual means
img_2003 = grace_2003.mean().clip(alabama)
img_2012 = grace_2012.mean().clip(alabama)

# 3. Check valid pixels
count_2003 = img_2003.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=alabama,
    scale=50000,  # GRACE has ~300km resolution, using 50km for safety
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('lwe_thickness').getInfo()

count_2012 = img_2012.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=alabama,
    scale=50000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('lwe_thickness').getInfo()

print(f"Valid pixels 2003: {count_2003}")
print(f"Valid pixels 2012: {count_2012}")

if count_2003 == 0 or count_2012 == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

# 4. Calculate mean water storage anomalies
val_2003 = img_2003.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry=alabama,
    scale=50000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('lwe_thickness').getInfo()

val_2012 = img_2012.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry=alabama,
    scale=50000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('lwe_thickness').getInfo()

print(f"2003 Mean Water Storage: {val_2003:.2f} cm")
print(f"2012 Mean Water Storage: {val_2012:.2f} cm")

# 5. Validation & Final Answer
if val_2003 is None or val_2012 is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif abs(val_2003) > 1000 or abs(val_2012) > 1000:  # Sanity check (unrealistic values)
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    # Check if 2012 value is lower than 2003 (decrease)
    if val_2012 < val_2003:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
